name: Maria Vázsan — husband and daughter named on a 1900 Bojnice baptism
researcher_question: Whom did Maria Vázsan, baptised 10 January 1853 at Bojnice (Bajmóc), Slovakia, daughter of Ignatius Vázsan and Anna Prividzer, marry, and what children did the marriage produce?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-4.csv row 24, hint-samples.csv row 811, flags adds_spouse/adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-10-27 as a FALSE MATCH on index/tree evidence; image_basis left unset (no register image was read or calibrated). The 1900 Bojnice baptism of Maria Czibula (ark:/61903/1:1:QVNW-6T7D; mother persona ark:/61903/1:1:QVNW-6T7X) names a 'Maria Vázsan' who is a different, younger woman: Maria Vázan (indexed spelling) baptised 20 Oct 1869 Bojnice (ark:/61903/1:1:QVNW-69C8), daughter of Franciscus (Ferencz) Vázan and Julianna Hoffmann, who married János Czibula (LJT8-8LP) on 21 Nov 1893 and bore four children 1894-1900; the hint mother persona is already attached on FamilySearch to that woman (LJT8-8L5), not to the subject. The subject (LJTH-GRX, bapt. 10 Jan 1853, daughter of Ignatius Vázsan and Anna Prividzer) is not this woman. A bounded index search surfaced no marriage or children identifiable as the subject's ('Maria Vázsan' is a common local name). Retrieval tool-assisted (record_read/person_read/record_search/source_attachments); the 1893 marriage record (bride aged 20, daughter of Ferencz Vázsan) is the researcher's own finding, not a tool-side image reading.
